chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:
The minimum that suffices from the Takbir during the turning (to prayer) is one Takbir; and three Takbirs are better, and seven are superior.

key_terms.التَّكْبِير: The act of saying 'Allahu Akbar' (God is Greater), a ritual utterance.
key_terms.التَّوَجُّهِ: The turning or orientation, specifically referring to the commencement of the prayer.

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and recommended number of Takbirs when starting prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the jurisprudential hierarchy for the Takbirat al-Ihram, distinguishing between the minimum validity (one), the recommended practice (three), and the optimal devotion (seven). It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *mustahabb* acts that enhance spiritual presence (*khushu*) during the transition from worldly affairs to divine communion. The gradation underscores the principle that while the pillar is fulfilled with one, excellence in worship is achieved through abundance in remembrance.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,
‘The lowest of what would suffice from the exclamation of Takbīr during the direction, is one Takbīr; and three Takbīrs are better, and seven would be superior’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by his father Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The least for Takbir (Allah is great beyond description) facing (al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah)) is to say it once. Three times is good and seven times is better.”’
